definitions: An arthropod of the large, mainly aquatic group Crustacea, such as a crab, lobster, shrimp, or barnacle, typically having a segmented body, an exoskeleton, and paired, jointed limbs.
examples: Crabs, lobsters, and shrimp are all types of crustaceans.
Many crustaceans are edible and form an important part of the human diet.
